Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of KEC International Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of KEC International Ltd. is ₹ 23,506.20 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 5.14% and a 3-year CAGR of 8.89%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of KEC International Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of KEC International Ltd. is ₹ 553.61 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of 41.85%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of KEC International Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of KEC International Ltd. is approximately ₹ 1,396.94 Cr (based on an operating margin of 5.94%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of KEC International Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of KEC International Ltd. is 20.80. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of KEC International Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of KEC International Ltd. stands at 0.87. The interest coverage ratio is 2.06x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of KEC International Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of KEC International Ltd. is 231.39 (derived from a P/B ratio of 1.49 and market price of ₹ 343.85), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of KEC International Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of KEC International Ltd. is ₹ -1,047.28 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does KEC International Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
KEC International Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
